title: Lifting & Inspection Management System
summary: Graduation thesis combining a custom Odoo 18 backend (oca_lifting_main), a Flutter mobile application, and an integrated AI predictive model for automated inspection cycles[cite: 1, 2].

title: Production Odoo 18 ERP Modules
summary: Engineered comprehensive ERP modules from scratch during internship at Lite System Technology[cite: 1], including company visit trackers, pipeline inspectors, sale credit approvals, and expense receipt previews.

title: CUPS Printer & Port Connection Tester
summary: Odoo utility module enabling administrators to diagnose network printers and raw socket ports directly from the ERP interface.

title: Partner Quick Google Maps & Waze Link
summary: Lightweight Odoo add-on injecting direct navigation and mapping shortcuts into partner views for field agents and logistics.

title: Python Excel Grouping & Automation Utility
summary: Python-based automation script engineered to eliminate manual tasks by parsing raw Excel data sets and executing thickness-based grouping.

title: Smart Car Parking & Robot Car System
summary: Embedded systems project featuring a real-time smart parking system using C++, Arduino, IR sensors, and servo motors, alongside a wireless-controlled robot car[cite: 2].
